engineering.title: Faculty of Engineering
engineering.kicker: A shared preparatory year, then three future-focused specializations
facts: Robotics projects, from line-following robots to 4- and 6-axis industrial robot models
AI students train in cloud, IoT and networking through Huawei's academy at EPNU
Workshops at the Suez Canal Authority Training Center; a signed protocol with BEDO for factory training and applied research
Teams at ITC-Egypt 2026 and the ICIAAI 2026 AI Hackathon

directors.label: Mechatronics & Automation · Engineering Programs · IR Office
directors.name: Assoc. Prof. Mohamed El-Sakka
directors.bio: PhD, University of Sheffield (UK); wind-energy and CFD research at Port Said University.

directors.label: AI & Machine Learning · Construction · Training Center
directors.name: Assoc. Prof. Asmaa Rady
directors.bio: PhD, University of Exeter (UK; Newton-Mosharafa scholar); research fellow, Politecnico di Torino.

cs.title: Faculty of Computer Science & IT
cs.kicker: Four-year programs built around AI, data and digital health
facts: Machine learning, intelligent systems and decision support across the programs
Biomedical Informatics builds systems on clinical data, biometrics and medical imaging
Qualified for the Egyptian Collegiate Programming Contest (ECPC) 2026; ICPC-style community contests on campus
Cooperation talks with ITI and Creativa Port Said on digital-skills training

directors.label: Director of the Faculty's Programs · Quality Assurance Center
directors.name: Prof. Osama El-Baksawy
directors.bio: Faculty member in Electrical Power & Machines Engineering at Port Said University. His research covers renewable energy, fractional-order control and metaheuristic optimization, with 24 indexed papers and 780+ citations (h-index 15, OpenAlex).

medicine.title: Faculty of Medicine
medicine.kicker: An integrated, English-medium MBBCh with early clinical exposure
programs: ECTS credit system, taught in English
facts: Basic sciences, clinical training and community service taught together
Students train with medical convoys at primary-care units in North Sinai
Medical students present papers at national conferences, including Ain Shams and Suez Canal universities
Port Said University's new university hospital; a signed protocol with Ahl Masr Hospital; MoU with 57357

directors.label: Program Director, Medicine & Surgery
directors.name: Assoc. Prof. Sherine El-Khouly
directors.bio: Leads the alignment of medical training and learning outcomes with Egypt's healthcare needs. She supervises student research, clinical training and community medical convoys, and holds a professional diploma (grade: Excellent) from GAHAR, Egypt's healthcare accreditation authority.

pharmacy.title: Faculty of Pharmacy
pharmacy.kicker: Clinical Pharmacy (PharmD) with a strong research and industry base
facts: HPLC and UV-Vis instruments, plus clinical simulation rooms for dose calculation
EIPICO, EVA Pharma, Lavender Life and Royal Cosmetics
Leads the Universiti Putra Malaysia partnership and joint webinars
Pharmacy and medicinal chemistry account for most of EPNU's international papers

directors.label: Program Director, Clinical Pharmacy · Entrepreneurship Club
directors.name: Assoc. Prof. Mohamed Yasser
directors.bio: Faculty member in the Department of Pharmaceutics, Faculty of Pharmacy, Port Said University. His interests include pharmaceutical and cosmetic formulation, and he champions entrepreneurship and innovation among EPNU's pharmacy students.

ahs.title: Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology
ahs.kicker: Training the technologists behind modern diagnostics
facts: Hematology, biochemistry, microbiology and microscopy labs
Training on X-ray, CT and MRI equipment, with radiation protection and quality standards
Port Said University Hospital, Saudi German Hospital Cairo, Ahl Masr Hospital and 57357
A signed MoU with the 57357 Group covers practical training and research

directors.label: Director of the Faculty's Programs
directors.name: Dr. Salma Khairallah
directors.bio: Directs both the Medical Laboratory and Medical Imaging programs. She holds a PhD in Biochemistry from Port Said University's Faculty of Science, where she previously directed the Biochemistry & Microbiology program.

business.title: Faculty of Business Sciences
business.kicker: Accounting and marketing for a digital economy
facts: Accounting information systems, financial software and financial analysis
Campaigns, e-commerce, platform management and consumer analytics
The faculty welcomed its first cohort with a dedicated orientation day
Pathways to accounting, auditing, taxation, banking, marketing and e-commerce roles

directors.label: Program Director, Accounting & Software Applications
directors.name: Dr. Ali Gomaa
directors.bio: Leads the Accounting & Software Applications program, which prepares students for accounting, auditing, financial analysis, taxation and financial-software careers.

arts.title: Faculty of Arts
arts.kicker: Humanities connected to technology and global communication
facts: Written and interpreting translation: medical, legal, literary and audiovisual
GIS, remote sensing, digital surveying and AI-based spatial analysis
Graduates target GIS, urban planning, smart cities and telecoms
Applied linguistics and communication for media, tourism and diplomacy
arts.side_text: The Faculty of Arts pairs language and translation with geospatial technology and AI. That makes it a natural partner for joint programs in translation studies, digital humanities and smart-city research.
